preregistered_by: product lane, offline machinery rehearsal for product/gate_packet.py
purpose_and_limit: NOT GATE MATERIAL. This manifest exists so the whole packet chain (three questions -> served retrieval -> bundle -> run-time admissibility -> per-query draft -> guard probe -> packet.json -> card -> recheck) can be executed offline and in CI, in a runner with no outbound network. The offline corpus is ONE recorded OpenCaseLaw scenario ('Kündigung Mietvertrag Mietrecht'), so every question below asks that same recorded question with a different language expectation: the packet machinery, the disclosures and the guards are exercised for real, and nothing about retrieval quality is claimed. product/gate_packet.py only ever reports a live packet as owner-ready.
method: identical to the real packet: within-question comparative session, same bundle in map and list view, four Master Prompt gate questions per question.
baseline: the conventional ranked list rendered by the accepted harness switch from the same bundle
success_rule: not applicable - this manifest never produces a gate verdict.
recorded_by_tool: a question whose bundle fails the run-time admissibility check is reported blocked and is never shipped to an owner ceremony
